method: For each RGB channel, round half up (source blush channel × donor light channel / original Celine light channel). Original light is #FCDEBE. Alpha remains255. These authored cosmetic targets are candidates, not native donor colors.
scope: Only source-bound cheek components. F4AEAE components on all affected expressions; FCB0B6 and E6687A only on the special-blush cheek patch. Single-color groups isolate shared lips, tongue, mouth, hair and clothes. All old skin slots and masks retained; old four presets append identity targets.
